denial.falsifier: Any source form that removes the @0x824 `mr` while KEEPING six pointers in r14-r19 -- i.e. reaches insns T958/O958 with no ours-only stack slot at 756 and with `mr r3,r14` present at the 0x578 site. A state that closes the mr and re-creates a +1 via a spill pair is not a falsifier; that is the measured pair.
denial.premise_measurement: Baseline `python tools/gdl/probe.py game/pb/pb_frame.c pbFrameMode --ops` = real 391, FUZZY (fresh report) 96.9885%, insns T958/O959, multiset 1t (`ours-only: -1 mr`), 20 clusters, 77 IMMEDIATE rows. The single count-delta site, from `fnasm game/pb/pb_frame.c pbFrameMode 0x7f0:0x86c --diff`: TARGET `@0x81c addi r0,r10,-1` / `@0x820 slwi r8,r0,6` / `@0x824 cmpwi r8,255` / `@0x828 subfic r9,r8,256`; OURS `@0x81c addi r0,r10,-1` / `@0x820 slwi r0,r0,6` / `@0x824 mr r8,r0` / `@0x828 cmpwi r8,255` / `@0x82c subfic r9,r0,256`. PROBE A removed the local: the 0x81c-0x844 block became BYTE-IDENTICAL to target (every row `=` in the aligned view, including `slwi r8,r0,6` and `subfic r9,r8,256`) and the @0x824 `mr` cluster vanished from the ops list -- but real went 391 -> 461 and the multiset went 1t -> 3t, to `target-only: +1 mr  ours-only: -1 lwz -1 stw`, with a NEW ours-only stack slot 756 carrying 2 uses. `fnasm ... 0x4e0:0x590 --diff` names the cost exactly: the TARGET promotes SIX pointers to callee-saved registers (`@0x52c addi r14,r1,440`, `@0x534 addi r15,r1,272`, `@0x538 addi r16,r1,528`, `@0x53c addi r17,r1,360`, `@0x540 addi r18,r1,616`, `@0x544 addi r19,r7,13604`) while ours after the edit promotes only FIVE (r14=r1+272 through r18=r7+13604) and spills r1+440 to the stack, so the target's `@0x578 mr r3,r14` becomes our `@0x57c lwz r3,752(r1)`. Both streams save from r14 (stmw base r14) and both frames are 864, so the save SET is identical and only the assignment differs. PROBE B then held the declaration and changed only the read (`aR = aRWork; aG = 256 - aR;`): NEUTRAL, real 391, multiset back to 1t -- i.e. the `mr` returned. The declaration, not the read, is the discriminant, and the two effects are ONE inseparable lever: `aRWork`'s existence buys a callee-saved promotion worth about 70 real and costs exactly one `mr`.
denial.scope: Removing the `aRWork` local from pbFrameMode's `smode <= 5` branch as a way to close the function's +1 instruction-count delta. It denies nothing about the other 19 ops clusters, the 77 IMMEDIATE rows, the four repeated stack-slot blocks at 760-788, the r7/r8 store-order pairs at 32/36..208/212, or any route to the count delta that does not go through deleting this local.

held_fixed: Both probes held the ARITHMETIC and the CONTROL FLOW constant: the value computed for aR is `(smode - 1) << 6` and for aG is `256 - aR` in every state, the two clamps stay `if (... > 255) ... = 255;` in the same order, `noBlend = 0;` keeps its position, and no other statement in pbFrameMode was touched. Probe A varied the local's EXISTENCE (aRWork declared vs not) together with the necessarily-coupled question of what the subtraction reads. Probe B was designed to hold the local's EXISTENCE fixed (aRWork still declared and still initialised from `(smode - 1) << 6`) while varying ONLY which variable the subtraction reads (`256 - aR` instead of `256 - aRWork`) -- that is the isolating probe, and it is what proves the declaration is the discriminant. The 13 sibling functions in pb_frame stayed at real 0 throughout, and the TU was returned to HEAD with `probe.py --discard` and an empty `git diff --numstat`.

hypothesis.cheapest_refuting_observation: Re-apply Probe A and read the slot map from `probe.py game/pb/pb_frame.c pbFrameMode --slots`. If the ours-only slot 756 does NOT appear -- i.e. the spill is not reproducible and the 70-real cost came from somewhere else -- the compensating-pair framing is wrong and the count delta is a plain one-site fix after all. Measured this run: slot 756 appeared with 2 uses and slots were otherwise identical (0t/1o exclusive).
hypothesis.screened_against_target: no -- every instruction, register and offset quoted above is read from the target's and our own fnasm dumps and is accurate, but the 'missing local elsewhere' claim is NOT screened: no census of pbFrameMode's declaration list against the target's promoted set was run this run, and the six-pointer block was read only at its promotion site, not traced back to which source variable holds r1+440.
hypothesis.statement: With `aRWork` removed the function is exactly ONE register-promotion candidate short, and the missing candidate is a local we have NOT recovered elsewhere in pbFrameMode -- not aRWork itself. The target's source contains neither the `mr` nor the spill, so it has both the direct `aR` assignment AND six promoted pointers; something in the target's declaration list is carrying the demand that `aRWork` is accidentally carrying in ours. The next lane should find that local rather than re-probing the aRWork site, and the six-pointer block at `@0x4ec-0x544` (the tplA1/tplA2/tplB1/tplB2/tplC1/tplC2 copies at source lines 487-492) is where its effect is measured.
